content.en_US:
5x5x7. An electric crucible with a built-in caster: it melts metals, alloys them by crucible recipe, then casts ingots directly.

Needs 600,000 TU before it smelts. Heats at 2,000 TU/t on 10,000 HE/t.

The 20 input slots are five rows of four. Row i only takes items that melt into metal i of the recipe - the wrong row is refused.

Molten metal caps at 75% (192,000 mB). Each metal gets a share by input ratio, so one full metal blocks the others.

Put HBM molds in the template slot to cast. Under 9 molds it waits 10 seconds before flushing. Slag casts without a mold.

A small unmarked GUI button dumps the melt as casting scrap.

Red upgrades: power x2/x8/x32, heating x2/x4/x8. Green upgrades only speed up alloying.

See also:
[[Battery Array|Battery Array]]
content.zh_CN:
带电的坩埚加连续铸造机: 熔金属、按坩埚配方合金, 再直接铸锭。

攒够 600,000 TU 才开始熔炼。升温 2,000 TU/t, 耗电 10,000 HE/t。

20 格原料是五排四列。第 i 排只收能熔成配方第 i 种金属的物品, 放错排直接拒收。

熔融金属上限 75% (192,000 mB)。每种金属按投入比例分额度, 一种灌满就会卡住其他几种。

模板槽放 HBM 模具才能铸造, 炉渣不用模具。

GUI 里有个没图标的小按钮, 会把熔融金属当铸造废料倒掉。

另见:
[[电池矩阵|Battery Array]]
